newsitem.title: TAIWAN: POLL-Taiwan end-'97 stocks seen at 10,792.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Taiwan end-'97 stocks seen at 10,792.

text.p: Taiwan's benchmark stock index will rise to 10,792 at the end of 1997, according to a straw poll conducted by Reuters Financial Television after the close of trading on Thursday.

Brokers at six institutions were unanimous that the index, which closed above 10,000 on Thursday for the first time since 1990, would surpass its all-time high close of 12,495 sometime in the third quarter but faced uncertainty in the fourth.
The weighted index closed at 10,066.35, a gain of 123.56 points or 1.24 percent compared to Wednesday's close.
